lines.zh: 我一身橘色，走起来像块陶。
lines.en: Orange all over. I walk like fired clay.
Clay legs. Every step lands solid.
I march as if being corrected.

lines.zh: 我朝敌人直线的方向走。
lines.en: I walk straight at the enemy.

lines.zh: 身上的颜色很显眼，我不在乎。
lines.en: My color shows. I don't care.
Step by step. Same rhythm.

lines.zh: 我脚下留着橘色的土屑。
lines.en: Orange crumbs under my feet.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候，肩膀是硬的。
lines.en: My shoulders are stiff when I turn.
Not fast. Never stopped.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过来，就这个方向。
lines.en: Coming at you. This direction.
My foot sinks halfway into soil.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边握紧手里的东西。
lines.en: Walking and gripping what I hold.
I stand. Awaiting orders.

lines.zh: 身上的橘色是染料，不是血。
lines.en: The orange is dye. Not blood.

lines.zh: 我低头看手，泥的纹路很清楚。
lines.en: I look at my hand. Clay lines clear.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃饭，也不需要睡。
lines.en: No food. No sleep.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我的棱角还在。
lines.en: The wind comes. My edges hold.

lines.zh: 我是黏土和灵魂沙做出来的。
lines.en: Made from clay and soul sand.

lines.zh: 我听见战场那边有动静。
lines.en: Movement over there. I hear it.

lines.zh: 我的关节不会响，但会掉渣。
lines.en: My joints don't creak. They crumble.
I raise my hand and check the weapon.
Someone's watching. I know.
You're a bit shorter. Just right.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，泥做的脸没表情。
lines.en: I look up. Clay face. No expression.
Are you my opponent?
Your hands are empty.

lines.zh: 我这样站着，是等你先动。
lines.en: I stand so you move first.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在看我身上的颜色。
lines.en: You're looking at my color.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，记住你的位置。
lines.en: I know you now. Position recorded.
One step back. Counted.

lines.zh: 我这身颜色是从染料里来的。
lines.en: This color came from a dye.
Are you laughing at my orange paint?
Open ground between us.
If you're coming, come.
A crumb fell off.
A layer of clay scraped off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 橙色的我，掉了一块还能站。
lines.en: Orange, and still standing with a chip missing.
Another crack.

lines.zh: 我不疼，我只是缺了一块。
lines.en: No pain. I'm just missing a piece.
That skewed my face.
I lift my hand. Fingers intact.
You knocked the color off me.
I'm shedding clay. Still fighting.

lines.zh: 你给我留下的痕迹，我记住了。
lines.en: I'll remember that mark.
I don't eat. I'm clay.

lines.zh: 你举着这个给我，真是浪费。
lines.en: Offering me that. Wasteful.
No need. No hunger.
Put it away.
I respond only to orders.
That won't upgrade me.

lines.zh: 我倒是认识木棍和燧石。
lines.en: Sticks and flint. Those I know.
Your goodwill. Noted.
Why not keep it yourself?
I'm not moving. You should understand.
You hit me like a clay jar.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，掉了一点渣。
lines.en: Half a step back. Some crumbs fell.
Don't press. My edges are hard.

lines.zh: 这一下，我肩膀缺了一块。
lines.en: That chipped my shoulder.
I shoulder you aside. Instinct.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我歪了一下，正回来了。
lines.en: That knocked me crooked. I straightened.
My color's on you now.
I'm not light. Don't shove.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁也别动。
lines.en: Wedged together. Nobody move.
Lift your foot — my fingers came off.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙捏出来的，也懂喜欢。
lines.en: Soul sand shaped me, but I still know fondness.
This body doesn't breed.
I have only fighting and standing by.
If you want to dye me, say so.

lines.zh: 另一个士兵？颜色不一样。
lines.en: Another soldier? Different color.
I need nobody beside me.
Back off. I'm holding this spot.
This clay can be reshaped.
Don't touch my face. It crumbles.
No response.

lines.zh: 握紧了，指缝挤出一点湿泥。
lines.en: I grip it and wet clay squeezes between my fingers.

lines.zh: 这重量合适，当武器正好。
lines.en: Good weight. Fine as a weapon.
I lift it overhead — taller than I am.
I pick it up and stuff it in my clay pocket.

lines.zh: 夹在胳膊下，走起来一晃。
lines.en: Tucked under my arm, it sways as I walk.
Yours. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 泥做的手抓不住太滑的。
lines.en: Clay hands can't grip smooth things.
This stick can serve as my spear.
I wedge it at my waist.
Light enough to carry.
Head-on is best; clay fists don't curve.
My hand's up. That's the start.
Orders came. I don't ask.
This ground is my post.
The orange clay is hardening now.
Toward you. Straight line.
Square to you. Feet planted.
I hear your breathing.
No other target. Only you.
I'm crumbling. It doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 木棍握紧了，橙色的我先上。
lines.en: Stick gripped tight — the orange one charges first.
My stance is low.

lines.zh: 你把武器拿出来了，很好。
lines.en: You drew a weapon. Good.
Now the fight starts.
Step by step, orange.

lines.zh: 我一步一印，橙色泥点溅开。
lines.en: Each step of mine splashes orange mud.
No detours. Straight is fastest.
There's a gap in your guard.

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色让你分心了。
lines.en: My color is distracting you.
I've raised the weapon.
Back to the wall and that's it.

lines.zh: 我的阵型只有我一个人。
lines.en: My formation is one soldier.

lines.zh: 你手里的棍子有多长，我量过。
lines.en: I've measured the reach of that club.
That in your hand won't stop me.

lines.zh: 石头碎了，我的脚趾也裂了。
lines.en: The stone cracked, and so did my toe.

lines.zh: 我再往前迈一步就到了。
lines.en: One more stride and I'm there.
My arm is up.
The line moves. Now.

lines.zh: 我把脚扎进泥里，扎稳了。
lines.en: I plant my feet in the soil.
I bring the club down.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的手上掉了泥。
lines.en: That cost my hand some clay.
You took two steps back. Held.
I slam in. Direct.

lines.zh: 皮甲上，多了一个泥掌印。
lines.en: Another clay palm print on your leather.
A clay hand has my collar.
Orange dye, all over me.
You missed the low line.
My arm cracked. Still works.
Orange dye is only a skin.
I followed with another.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了黏土的劲。
lines.en: That had clay's weight behind it.
A small clay fist leaves a mud print.

lines.zh: 你被震得往后退，脚下打滑。
lines.en: The blow shoves you back. Your feet slip.
My hand rises again. Clay flakes fall.

lines.zh: 我这一下没用巧劲，只有重量。
lines.en: No finesse. Just weight.
I was shaped and set down.
I stand. Knees still soft.
The orange isn't dry yet.
I land. Clay crumbs in a ring.
I open my eyes on a battlefield.

lines.zh: 身上还有灵魂沙的味道。
lines.en: Soul sand still on me.

lines.zh: 我举起手里的东西，先看看。
lines.en: I lift what I'm holding. A look first.

lines.zh: 我选了个正对敌人的位置。
lines.en: I take a spot facing the enemy.

lines.zh: 我的颜色是我自己挑的。
lines.en: I picked this color myself.
This place needs someone standing.

lines.zh: 我站直了，等你放我出去。
lines.en: I'm upright. Waiting for release.
First movement for this clay body.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的表面变硬发黑。
lines.en: Fire hardened my surface black.
Fell. A leg cracked off.
Soaked in water. I'm softening.
The blast took half my body.
An arrow sticks in my chest like a ceramic pin.

lines.zh: 这力量让我身上的泥在动。
lines.en: That power makes the clay shift.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但身体在干裂。
lines.en: I don't eat. The clay still dries.

lines.zh: 雷打在泥上，我一下就硬了。
lines.en: Lightning fired the clay hard.

lines.zh: 往下掉，泥块一块块散开。
lines.en: Falling. The clay comes apart in pieces.
